metadata.description: AI tools for SelectPdf — skills, agents and references that teach AI coding assistants to use the SelectPdf .NET library and online API correctly.

plugins.name: selectpdf
plugins.description: Expert skills for the SelectPdf .NET libraries: SelectPdf.Universal (cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon, Docker) and the classic Select.Pdf library for Windows, each with its free Community Edition. HTML to PDF, Word to PDF, PDF creation and editing, merge, AcroForms, digital signatures and validation, redaction, encryption, PDF to text/image, accessible tagged PDF/UA and PDF/A, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X. C# and VB.NET.
